submitting: Sending the local request. Job acceptance has not yet been confirmed.
requestFailureRecovery: No automatic retry is performed. Check the local demo connection and job state before starting another request. This message does not confirm that remote work or billing has stopped.

accessDenied.title: Access denied
accessDenied.body: This private project accepts only its configured owner. Check the authorized session; do not share credentials or disable authentication.

invalidRequest.title: Request not accepted
invalidRequest.body: The selected request is not supported. No alternative asset or language is substituted.

conflict.title: Request identity conflict
conflict.body: The request identity was already used for different input. Inspect the existing job before submitting another request.

limited.title: Request limit reached
limited.body: This request was limited. Repeated clicks or automatic retries are not used to bypass the limit.

missing.title: Job is unavailable
missing.body: The requested job could not be found. This does not confirm that a worker has stopped.

provider.title: Market-data request failed
provider.body: The data provider did not return a usable result. Visible demo prices are not replacement live data.

model.title: Analysis could not be produced
model.body: A validated analysis is unavailable. No generated text or sample insight is substituted for this failed result.

launch.title: Worker launch was not confirmed
launch.body: The service reported a task-launch failure. This screen cannot verify worker termination or billing state.

internal.title: Service could not complete the request
internal.body: A service error prevented a verified result. Internal error details are not displayed.

invalidResponse.title: Response could not be verified
invalidResponse.body: The response did not match the expected contract or local fixture. Its content is not displayed as a trusted result.

requestFailed.title: Request could not be completed
requestFailed.body: A verified response was not received. Check the local demo connection; do not interpret this as missing market data or proof that no job started.

stopWaitingNote: Stops this screen's waiting only. It does not stop a remote worker or guarantee that billing has stopped.
waitingStoppedBody: Local waiting and result updates have stopped. This is not confirmation that a remote job or billing has stopped. This demo does not call AWS.
waitingStoppedRecovery: No automatic retry is performed. Starting another local demo requires an explicit new click; verify remote work before retrying in a live system.

quoteLabels.timezoneNote: US Eastern time is a display conversion using America/New_York. It does not verify the exchange calendar or whether trading is open.

priceDoneBody: The displayed quote is a local fixture, not a newly fetched market price. No AI analysis was run. Choose Analyze with AI to view the sample analysis.
priceCompleteAnnouncement: {symbol}: price-check demo complete. The displayed price is a local fixture; no AI analysis was run.
analysisCompleteAnnouncement: {symbol}: analysis demo complete. The sample insight is ready; no live model was called.
demoHelp: Presentation simulation only. This does not call AWS, start or stop a worker, or change the real circuit.
circuitBody: This simulates an open circuit rejecting a new request. No job was started and no real AWS setting was changed.
timeoutBody: This simulates a waiting timeout, not confirmation that a real worker has stopped. In a live system, check the job and worker state before retrying.
dataUnavailableBody: No verified result is available for this request. No substitute asset or invented result is used. Any price still displayed is a local demo fixture, not a result of this request.
recoveryHint: There is no automatic retry. For a local success example, select another supported asset and Normal result, then choose Check price or Analyze with AI. SPCX remains unavailable because its identity is unverified.
heroCopy: Latest available market context and grounded AI insight, designed to show what the data says — and what it cannot say.
heroNoteBody: No live provider, Bedrock, or AWS resource is connected. All visible prices are clearly labeled fixtures.
marketClosed: Market closed · sample as of Aug 7, 2026
spcxMockSource: SPCX identity/provider coverage is unverified. No price or analysis is fabricated.
emptyTitle: Insight is ready when you are
emptyBody: Select an asset, then start an analysis job. The local demo mirrors the planned asynchronous AWS experience.
unavailableBody: SPCX must be validated with the selected provider. The application will never substitute another security or fabricate a quote.
disclaimer: Educational market insight only — not financial advice. Demo values are synthetic contract fixtures and are not current prices.
architectureBody: The AWS release will create a job, launch one Fargate worker, store a validated result, and stop — with no always-on service in the primary architecture.
footerLeft: Global Market AI Insight · Portfolio project
footerRight: Data freshness first · No trading execution
localHttpDemo: Local HTTP fixture mode · 127.0.0.1 only · No AWS, provider or model calls · Test API closes after 5 minutes
